organization.discoveryNotes: Healthcare template: hospitals/clinics, clinical workflows, PHI-aware security, and NCA-aligned identity baseline.

workflows.name: Patient admission & registration
workflows.description: Reception captures demographics; clinical record opened with role-based access.

workflows.name: Clinical order approval
workflows.description: Orders above scope require department head sign-off; full audit trail.

workflows.name: Security incident (CyberCrow)
workflows.description: PHI access anomaly or breach routed to compliance and CISO workflow.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for all clinical and admin privileged accounts
Role-based access to patient identifiers (PDPL / PHI policy)
Audit logging on record view and export
NCA ECC alignment for identity and access management
Session timeout on shared clinical workstations

integrations.notes: SSO for hospital staff; conditional access for clinical VLAN
Optional ERP for finance and supply (medical consumables)

experienceRequirements.requirement: Occupancy, revenue cycle, open incidents, compliance posture KPIs
Department workload, pending approvals, staffing overview
Task-focused UI; minimal PHI on screen; fast handoff between shifts

identity.ssoNotes: Healthcare template: Entra ID + MFA mandatory for clinical and billing admins; break-glass procedure documented.

security.complianceNotes: Patient data under PDPL; segregate clinical, billing, and HR datasets; no PHI in non-production environments.
